caption: The drawing depicts a circular, reddish-brown plate with a decorative design and inscription around the rim. The central motif features a symmetrical composition consisting of a single stylized flower with a round, textured blossom colored in shades of brown and green at the top, and a thin, wavy stem descending to the plate's center. Flanking the central stem are two large, six-pointed stars, one on each side, each with alternating green and yellow sections and containing circular, striped patterns in the center. Beneath the stars and on either side of the stem are two curved leaf or feather shapes in cream and brown tones. The plate's outer edge is inscribed with text in a yellow color, following the curve of the rim, and is bordered by a thin green line within the reddish-brown background. The artist's signature and date, "E.H. Sellinaday / 1915," is present on the lower right of the surrounding cream-colored background.
title: Pennsylvania German Dish
